description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested classes and interfaces, which provide an abstraction for secure socket communication, including certificate handling, validation, and socket state management within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Main class providing secure socket communication with nested Certificate and IValidator classes, and internal Handler class managing socket states and data transfer.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing methods to retrieve issuer, subject, validity period, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Internal class inheriting from Core::SocketPort, managing socket states, data transfer, and handshake validation.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate's hostname matches the expected hostname.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Verify
methods.description: Verifies the certificate and returns success or error message.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events for the socket.
